tools.name: search_panels
tools.description: Find SMM panels (wholesale social-media-marketing resellers) tracked by PanelCompare, ranked by score, price, trust, uptime, provider score or catalogue uniqueness, optionally filtered by platform, payment method, feature or minimum trust score. Returns each panel with its trust score (0-100), overa

tools.name: get_panel
tools.description: One SMM panel's full profile on PanelCompare: trust and component scores with how much evidence backs them, uptime, features, payment methods, supply chain and provider meter, and its cheapest listing for each service it sells, each with the market median for comparison. Use the slug from search_pan

tools.name: compare_service_prices
tools.description: Who sells one service (e.g. Instagram followers, TikTok views, Spotify plays) and at what price per 1,000, cheapest first, with the market price index for it: median, quartiles and the quotable cheapest/dearest. Use list_services for valid platform and service slugs.

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: The latest daily price index: for every service, the median, quartiles and quotable cheapest/dearest price per 1,000 across all panels, with how many panels sell it. Optionally one platform only.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The canonical services PanelCompare tracks (platform and service slugs, unit, reference price range), optionally for one platform.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Totals across the index: panels listed and how many of them have live prices read, platforms, canonical services, listings, and the cheapest quotable rate. Quote a price figure with the priced-panel count, not the listed total.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_panels" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
